purpose: Teach: ぶろ/リーチ/ジーニョ/レナ/ヤス/キラー/ドタバタ/バーン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、「ぶろ気取り」って言葉使ってたな
lines.en: Riku — you used to say "pro-style" all the time.
lines.style: Light, teasing lilt. Accusatory but playful. Slight smile under the words. Testing him with something small and harmless, watching for his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、麻雀部でリーチ掛けるの上手だな、桜
lines.en: You're actually good at calling riichi in mahjong club, Sakura.
lines.style: Flat deflection disguised as a compliment. Eyes flick up briefly then away. Trying to redirect without admitting he was listening to her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ロナウジーニョのファンだったな
lines.style: Genuinely curious, probing gently. Not accusatory this time. Pulling at a thread she noticed, wanting to see if he remembers loving something that openly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ペットの名前レナちゃんにしたよな、桜
lines.en: You named your pet Rena, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost conversational. A small detail he kept. Not defensive—just stating what he noticed about her, turning the mirror back.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、「ヤスい店巡り」してたな
lines.en: Riku — you were always hunting for cheap restaurants.
lines.style: Amused, knowing. Slight eye-roll affection. The tone of someone who watched him do this repeatedly and found it endearing in spite of itself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、サッカー部でキラーパス出すの上手だな、桜
lines.en: You're really good at killer passes in soccer club, Sakura.
lines.style: Steady, genuine. Less defensive this time. A real compliment slipping through, offered without the same wall. Still brief—but honest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ドタバタコメディ漫画読みすぎだな
lines.en: Riku — you read way too much slapstick comedy manga.
lines.style: Mock exasperation with underlying amusement. A familiar complaint delivered like a running joke between them. Shaking her head slightly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゲームで爆発音「バーン」のSE好きだったな、桜
lines.en: You really liked that explosion sound effect in games, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, almost vulnerable observation. Caught himself noticing something specific about her. Slight pause before delivering it, like he's testing whether it's safe to say.
